purpose.zh: 练核心抗旋转，稳住躯干
purpose.en: Train your core to resist rotation and keep your trunk steady.

text.zh: 双手从胸前向前推直，躯干不转向固定点
text.en: Press your hands straight out without letting your trunk turn to the anchor

text.zh: 侧对固定点站直，膝盖微屈
text.en: Stand tall side-on to the anchor with soft knees.

text.zh: 推直后停两秒，再收回胸前
text.en: Hold for two seconds with arms straight, then bring your hands back.

commonErrors.en: Letting the trunk rotate toward the anchor.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.
